# Blora Design

> Token-driven, accessible, zero-dependency Web UI design system for Bloret applications.

## System

Blora Design is a Web UI design system based on native HTML semantics, Web Components (Custom Elements + Shadow DOM), and CSS Custom Properties (Design Tokens). It supports light/dark themes, RTL, and WCAG 2.2 AA.

## Installation

```bash
pnpm add @bloret-crew/blora-design
# or
npm install @bloret-crew/blora-design
```

## Core Principles

- Prefer native HTML elements; use Custom Elements only for composite interactions.
- Design Tokens drive all visual properties (DTCG JSON → generated CSS).
- Zero runtime third-party dependencies in the core package.
- ESM-first, SSR-safe, CSP-friendly.
- Progressive enhancement: components work without JavaScript where possible.

## Key Entry Points

- Package: `@bloret-crew/blora-design`
- Full docs: `docs/`
- Component contracts: `packages/blora-design/contracts/*.contract.json`
- Contract schema: `packages/blora-design/schemas/component-contract.schema.json`
- Component matrix: `docs/refactor/component-matrix.md`
- Migration guide: `docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md` (Phase 8)

## Component Index

Components are being migrated from 1.x to 2.0. See `docs/refactor/component-matrix.md` for current status.

## Prohibitions

- Do not extract visual styles from historical commits, old npm packages, or other UI frameworks.
- Do not use `innerHTML` with untrusted strings.
- Do not hardcode colors, spacing, radii, shadows, durations, or z-index in component CSS.
- Do not add public APIs without updating the contract and API snapshot.
- Do not skip tests or fabricate empty tests.

## Migration

1.x → 2.0 migration guide will be at `docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md` (Phase 8).
Codemod and `migrate:check` tool will be available in Phase 8.
